items.reason: A gentle peptide cream suits your wish for a smoother, firmer-looking appearance and adds comfort to dry-feeling skin.
A moderate-strength retinol for nights to help soften the look of fine lines and uneven texture.
Retinol can make skin more sun-sensitive, so a mineral SPF 50 is added for daily protection.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night, starting two or three nights a week and building up as your skin feels comfortable, with the peptide cream over it or in the morning. Apply the mineral SPF every morning as the last step, and reapply if you are outdoors for long.
